
{{alias}}( N, alpha, x, strideX )
    Generates a real elementary reflector (Householder matrix).

    The routine generates a real elementary reflector `H` such that
    `H * [alpha; x] = [beta; 0]`, where `H` is an orthogonal matrix
    represented as `H = I - tau * v * v^T`.

    The vector `x` is modified in-place and contains `v[1:N]` on exit,
    where `v[0] = 1`.

    Indexing is relative to the first index. To introduce an offset, use typed
    array views.

    If `N = 1`, then `tau = 0` and `H` is the identity matrix.

    Parameters
    ----------
    N: integer
        Number of elements in vector `v`.

    alpha: number
        Scalar alpha.

    x: Float64Array
        Input vector.

    strideX: integer
        Index increment for `x`.

    Returns
    -------
    tau: number
        Scalar factor of the elementary reflector.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 ] );
    > var tau = {{alias}}( 3, 4.0, x, 1 )
    ~1.714
    > x
    <Float64Array>[ ~-0.557, ~-0.742, ~-0.371 ]


{{alias}}.ndarray( N, alpha, x, strideX, offsetX )
    Generates a real elementary reflector using alternative indexing semantics.

    Parameters
    ----------
    N: integer
        Number of elements in vector `v`.

    alpha: number
        Scalar alpha.

    x: Float64Array
        Input vector.

    strideX: integer
        Index increment for `x`.

    offsetX: integer
        Starting index for `x`.

    Returns
    -------
    tau: number
        Scalar factor of the elementary reflector.

    Examples
    --------
    > var x = new {{alias:@stdlib/array/float64}}( [ 0.0, 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 ] );
    > var tau = {{alias}}.ndarray( 3, 4.0, x, 1, 1 )
    ~1.714
    > x
    <Float64Array>[ 0.0, ~-0.557, ~-0.742, ~-0.371 ]

    See Also
    --------
